messages:
liz_chen: FYI — spotted a negative embed adjustment on Polaris' Feb invoice after running the replay. System shows a credit of $4,312 tied to a reduction of 23,114 embed units. Posting findings here for quick ops + finance decision.

sarah-g: Which replay job? can we see the delta by action?

liz_chen: replay id: replay_2026_02_17_3345. Ran a quick ledger rollup: action=ins (412,134), action=del (435,248) => net -23,114.

ops_jun: We shipped SDK dedupe changes in Jan that changed client_generated_id semantics. Could be the dedupe logic flagged replays as corrections. Paste the SQL used?

liz_chen: SQL snippet:
```
SELECT action, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM embed_ledger
WHERE replay_id = 'replay_2026_02_17_3345'
GROUP BY action;
```
Results included above.

reconcile-bot: Alert: auto-credit rule "suppress_retries_v2" triggered for customer=polaris during 2026-02-16..2026-02-18. Credits applied: 23114 embed units; monetary credit: $4,312. Details: /billing/credits/9876

mike-true: From finance perspective: if platform miscounted, reverse the credit and reissue invoice. But do not bill the customer extra without CS approval. Legal OK required for reversing >$2k? Confirm.

cs-alex: Please route comms to CS before any reversal. Customer expects explanation; we shouldn't surprise them.

liz_chen: Plan proposal: 1) Open reversal ticket, attach ledger CSV and replay link. 2) Reissue corrected invoice. 3) Offer a small goodwill credit (10% of disputed amount) to keep customer happy. Seeking quick approvals.

sarah-g: GL codes: use 6302 (customer credits) to record the reversal, offset 4101 for the revenue correction. I'll flag in the ticket.

ops_jun: Root cause fix: change dedupe pipeline to treat replayed batches as idempotent increments unless explicit correction flag present. We'll backfill counts and run a validation job. ETA: patch next week and run a non-destructive reconciler.

mike-true: Approved to proceed with reversal workflow up to $5k pending legal sign-off and CS notification. If legal refuses, escalate to CFO.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4529 assigned to billing-team with attachments.

liz_chen: Draft to CS for edit:
"Hi Polaris — we discovered an internal reconciliation issue that caused an incorrect credit on your Feb invoice for embed usage. We're reversing the internal credit and will issue an updated invoice within 3 business days. As a courtesy, we're applying a 10% one-time credit of the disputed amount. We'll follow up with the reconciliation CSV and a brief technical note on the replay. Thanks for your patience."

cs-alex: Looks good; please add a calendar invite for a 15m walkthrough.

sarah-g: Marking this P1 in billing queue. Finance will hold the reversal until legal sign-off confirmed. Close loop here once reversal and reissue are complete. :thumbsup:
